---
title: "Document Intake Covenant"
---

This page is retained as a stable reference point for older links. The public method for document intake, publication standards, and validation checks now lives in [Method](method.qmd).

New material should still be handled under the same covenant: raw material is preserved carefully, publication is not canonization, and every document should serve faithful discernment rather than mere accumulation.

Read [Method](method.qmd) for the current intake flow, intake questions, publication standards, validation commands, and review posture.
